Aaaaaand the Return from Miss Teen Colorado Runner-Up.

"Will, we absolutely can't take her. She's a liability. It's really just that simple," Bart said with zero sympathy.

 

It's like I wasn't even there. Which I can understand. Being the only female left in our stronghold in the middle of the forest in Georgia, I would crave another female to align with. The last female--alive--I saw was my mother two weeks ago. And she was getting her throat ripped out by a Class B Zombie--a biter as Will, Bart and I watched. There was nothing we could do. She was already sick before we lost almost everyone. Everything.

 

"Okay, but she's done so much for in us tight spots before! Remember how she thought of flanking when a few zippers pursued us? What? You think she's gonna choke?" At least Will was sticking up for me.

 

Will thought my fight-or-flight instincts, or as I muse strategic acumen, against some Class Cs--chasers--was worth bringing me along for whatever foraging they wanted to do. We called them zippers because after some got sustenance, they gained major speed. Lying in my makeshift sleeping bag, I stared at the stars trying to forget the feelings that washed over me now. What I would give to take out the first person who got sick and spread this all over.

 

"It's not that, you fucking dimwit! Three is always better than two! It's just that we can't risk losing her. I don't know if we're coming back after this one, Will. I really don't."

 

I hung my head in shame. They were protecting me.

 

"Come on, let's go. Hopefully, we're here to wake her up."
